videos.title: Shingles Vaccines Prevent Dementia
videos.author: SciShow
videos.description:
For decades, scientists have known that there was a weird link between shingles and dementia. But recent studies have made the connection clearer than ever—and established that the shingles vaccine may prevent the cognitive decline. 

Hosted by: @okidokiboki (she/her)

videos.title: You Actually Can Get Rid of Forever Chemicals
videos.author: SciShow
videos.description:
If you’ve used non-stick cookware recently or bought water-resistant clothes, you might have heard about PFAS, or “forever chemicals.” And while it is very hard to break down the PFAS polluting our environment, it is not impossible. Here is how we might get rid of forever chemicals.

Hosted by: Sava

videos.title: What Science Says About the Sequels to Ozempic
videos.author: SciShow
videos.description:
Ozempic, and drugs like it, are powerful, versatile, and have made a huge difference in people’s lives. But bigger, better, beefier spins on the Ozempic approach are on the horizon. So let’s take a look at how they work in order to understand the sequel to Ozempic.
